description: A monophonic pitch track by PESTO (mir-1k_g7 checkpoint, pinned by digest) at a 10 ms step on 16 kHz mono: the pitch and PESTO's confidence. Meant for one line, a vocal stem by --from stems/vocals or the bass stem by --from stems/bass. Version 2 adds the level of the same audio on the same rows, for a note builder. Runs under the operator's f0-python, so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch.

f0.description: one row every 160 samples at 16 kHz (10 ms), columns the pitch in Hz (0 where the tracker gives none) and PESTO's confidence, 0 to 1

rows_from_tracker.description: rows the tracker returned before the track was cut, or padded with zeros, to the grid: n // 160 + 1 rows for n samples

level_db.description: the RMS level of the level.frame samples (20 ms) of the decoded 16 kHz audio centred on each row of f0 (outside the audio is silence), floored at level.floor_db

loud_db.description: the level.loud_percentile percentile of level_db: the audio's loud level
